data: NetRAD node-3 HH/VV, existing raw Data_matched
target_amplitude: One CN(0,1) complex amplitude held across each complete acquisition window and its prefix
psf: Idealized zero-phase rectangular-spectrum sinc; no measured or provider-verified complex PSF
injection_domain: Raw matched-filter sample units; fixed provider-style mean/power transform applied to both clutter and target
null_policy: All observed clutter pulses retained; no hit-based exclusion
reporting_scope: Idealized physical-response/timing sensitivity on measured clutter, not real-target validation or verified hardware response
